['Fressnapf Holding SE '].company_description: Fressnapf Holding SE is Europe's market leader for pet supplies, with a focus on pet food and supplies. The company has extended its master agreement and digital development partnership with the IT service provider q.beyond. Fressnapf has invested in its omnichannel eco-system and operates multiple logistics centers in Europe to facilitate business expansion.

['Nestl\u00e9 Deutschland AG '].company_description: Nestlé Deutschland AG is the German subsidiary company of the food multinational company Nestlé. It is one of Germany's main food companies. Nestlé Deutschland AG offers a wide range of products including After Eight Mint Chocolate Thins, which are a brand of mint chocolate covered sugar confectionery.
